controls.html: <input data-quality-field="enabled" aria-label="啟用品質策略" type="checkbox">
<input data-quality-field="stable_samples" aria-label="穩定樣本數（1–100 筆）" type="number" min="1" max="100" step="1">
<input data-quality-field="stable_interval_seconds" aria-label="穩定樣本間隔（秒）" type="number" min="1" max="86400" step="1">
<input data-quality-field="stable_duration_seconds" aria-label="穩定窗口跨度（秒）" type="number" min="1" max="86400" step="1">
<input data-quality-field="permit_ttl_seconds" aria-label="許可最長有效期 TTL（秒）" type="number" min="1" max="86400" step="1">
<input data-quality-field="required.refill" aria-label="本輪必要階段：補水（至少一項；不改啟用設定）" type="checkbox">
<input data-quality-field="required.nutrient" aria-label="本輪必要階段：加養（至少一項；不改啟用設定）" type="checkbox">
<input data-quality-field="required.acid" aria-label="本輪必要階段：加酸（至少一項；不改啟用設定）" type="checkbox">
<input data-quality-field="required.mix" aria-label="本輪必要階段：混合（至少一項；不改啟用設定）" type="checkbox">
<select data-quality-field="ph.mode" aria-label="pH 新實測來源模式"><option value="reported">reported</option><option value="sequence">sequence</option><option value="timestamp">timestamp</option></select>
<input data-quality-field="ph.attribute" aria-label="pH 來源屬性（reported 留空；最多128 Unicode字元）" type="text">
<input data-quality-field="ph.confirmed" aria-label="pH 已確認上游新實測合約" type="checkbox">
<select data-quality-field="ec.mode" aria-label="EC 新實測來源模式"><option value="reported">reported</option><option value="sequence">sequence</option><option value="timestamp">timestamp</option></select>
<input data-quality-field="ec.attribute" aria-label="EC 來源屬性（reported 留空；最多128 Unicode字元）" type="text">
<input data-quality-field="ec.confirmed" aria-label="EC 已確認上游新實測合約" type="checkbox">

<select data-quality-field="level.mode" aria-label="液位 新實測來源模式"><option value="reported">reported</option><option value="sequence">sequence</option><option value="timestamp">timestamp</option></select>
<input data-quality-field="level.attribute" aria-label="液位 來源屬性（reported 留空；最多128 Unicode字元）" type="text">
<input data-quality-field="level.confirmed" aria-label="液位 已確認上游新實測合約" type="checkbox">
